title: Moments that occur only in the first two months of marriage.
title_hi: विवाह के पहले दो महीनों में होने वाले क्षण।
content:
No matter how long a courtship period you had with your partner before marriage or the number of years you have dated your lover, life takes a turn once you get married. You start sharing a roof (and your life) with your partner and in-laws, and you take your own time to adjust to this new lifestyle. Here are a few things that usually happen in the initial months of marriage with every couple.

 

1. ​You discover their new habits

From the very first day of this conjugal bond, you will discover the habits of your partner which you never knew existed. What your partner does before hitting the bed, the way they behave in front of their parents, their morning rituals, their bathroom habits, and several other habits that might be weird for you. The first few months of your marriage would be all about observing and adapting to each other's style of living.

 

2. ​The first argument

Countless thoughts might trouble your mind the day you will have your first serious argument or fight with your partner. Have I made the right choice? Would it be right to apologize and adjust? Whom should I confess about this fight? Oh, wait! Will my partner share this with his parents? But slowly and gradually, as your relationship stands the test of time, you find ways to deal with little quarrels.

 

3. ​Money matters

You both might have different spending habits and might have to struggle a little to find a middle path after tying the knot. You might not like your husband’s frugal ways of living or he might raise eyebrows when you splurge on online shopping. It would take some time and serious discussions to figure out a mutually acceptable way of managing the finances.

 

4. ​You will enjoy this new status

Like other newly-married couples, you too will enjoy this new relationship status. You might feel proud and happy when someone addresses you as a 'wife' or 'husband'. Your conversations with friends and family would also revolve around your spouse and married life, your last trip together, future plans, the relationship you share with your in-laws and the list is endless.

 

5. ​You will go down the memory lane

For the first few months, you both will talk about your wedding and go down the memory lane. From the nosy relatives who gossiped, the ones who did not like the food, the hectic and extravagant wedding preparations to the time you spent together during the honeymoon, you will always have something to talk about while cuddling in the bed.

 

6. ​What about me-time?

You might find yourself a lot busier after getting hitched. You will spend most of your spare time catching up with your partner, in-laws and friend circle, going for dinner or lunch with relatives, doing household chores, etc. Amidst all this, you will crave for me-time and might even miss your bachelor days when you were on your own and had ample free time in hand.

कोई फर्क नहीं पड़ता कि शादी से पहले आपने अपने साथी के साथ कितनी लंबी अवधि की अवधि या अपने प्रेमी को जितने वर्षों तक डेट किया है, शादी करने के बाद जीवन एक मोड़ लेता है। आप अपने साथी और ससुराल वालों के साथ एक छत (और अपने जीवन) साझा करना शुरू करते हैं, और आप इस नई जीवन शैली को समायोजित करने के लिए अपना समय लेते हैं। यहाँ कुछ चीजें हैं जो आमतौर पर शादी के शुरुआती महीनों में हर जोड़े के साथ होती हैं।

 

1. आप उनकी नई आदतों का पता लगाते हैं

इस संयुग्म बंधन के पहले दिन से, आपको अपने साथी की उन आदतों का पता चल जाएगा, जिन्हें आप कभी नहीं जानते थे। बिस्तर से टकराने से पहले आपका साथी क्या करता है, जिस तरह से वे अपने माता-पिता के सामने व्यवहार करते हैं, उनकी सुबह की रस्में, उनकी बाथरूम की आदतें और कई अन्य आदतें जो आपके लिए अजीब हो सकती हैं। आपकी शादी के पहले कुछ महीने एक-दूसरे की जीवन शैली को देखने और अपनाने के बारे में होंगे।

 

2. पहला तर्क

अनगिनत विचार आपके मन को परेशान कर सकते हैं जिस दिन आपके पास अपना पहला गंभीर तर्क होगा या अपने साथी के साथ लड़ाई होगी। क्या मैंने सही चुनाव किया है? क्या माफी मांगना और समायोजित करना सही होगा? मुझे इस लड़ाई के बारे में किसे स्वीकार करना चाहिए? अरे रुको! क्या मेरा साथी इसे अपने माता-पिता के साथ साझा करेगा? लेकिन धीरे-धीरे और धीरे-धीरे, जैसा कि आपका रिश्ता समय की कसौटी पर खड़ा है, आप छोटे झगड़ों से निपटने के तरीके ढूंढते हैं।

 

3. पैसा मायने रखता है

आप दोनों की खर्च करने की आदतें अलग हो सकती हैं और गाँठ बांधने के बाद बीच का रास्ता निकालने के लिए थोड़ा संघर्ष करना पड़ सकता है। हो सकता है कि आप अपने पति के रहने के तरीके को पसंद न करें या ऑनलाइन शॉपिंग के दौरान आप भौंहें उठा सकते हैं। वित्त के प्रबंधन के एक पारस्परिक रूप से स्वीकार्य तरीके का पता लगाने में कुछ समय और गंभीर चर्चा होगी।

 

4. आप इस नई स्थिति का आनंद लेंगे

अन्य नव-विवाहित जोड़ों की तरह, आप भी इस नए रिश्ते की स्थिति का आनंद लेंगे। जब कोई आपको 'पत्नी' या 'पति' कहकर संबोधित करता है तो आप गर्व और खुशी महसूस कर सकते हैं। मित्रों और परिवार के साथ आपकी बातचीत आपके जीवनसाथी और दांपत्य जीवन, आपकी अंतिम यात्रा, भविष्य की योजनाओं, आपके ससुराल वालों के साथ साझा किए गए संबंधों और सूची के अंत तक घूमती रहेगी।

 

5. आप मेमोरी लेन नीचे चले जाएंगे

पहले कुछ महीनों के लिए, आप दोनों अपनी शादी के बारे में बात करेंगे और मेमोरी लेन को छोड़ देंगे। गपशप करने वाले उन नादान रिश्तेदारों से, जिन्हें खाना पसंद नहीं था, हनीमून के दौरान साथ में बिताए जाने वाले व्यस्त और फ़ालतू शादी की तैयारियाँ, आपको बिस्तर में चुदवाते समय हमेशा कुछ न कुछ बोलते रहना पड़ेगा।

 

6. मेरे बारे में क्या है?

हो सकता है कि अड़चन आने के बाद आप खुद को बहुत व्यस्त समझें। आप अपना अधिकांश खाली समय अपने साथी, ससुराल वालों और मित्र मंडली के साथ बिताने, रिश्तेदारों के साथ डिनर या लंच पर जाने, घर के काम करने आदि में बिताएंगे। इन सबके बीच, आप मेरे लिए तरसेंगे-समय भी गंवा सकते हैं और चूक भी सकते हैं। अपने स्नातक दिनों जब आप अपने दम पर थे और हाथ में खाली समय था।

related.title: Things that will make your break-up less painful
related.title_hi: ऐसी चीजें जो आपके ब्रेकअप को कम दर्दनाक बना देंगी
related.content:
Dealing with a break-up is one of the hardest battles we fight with ourselves. The person you loved (or still love) is no longer a part of your life and now, the road ahead looms to be an endless emotional struggle. It is surely not an easy phase but with the right thinking and pragmatic approach, heartbreak can be dealt with a little less pain. Here are the three things that will make this tumultuous time easier to get through.

 

Accept the reality

Take a deep breath and come to terms with reality. You have broken up and now, there is no going back. Accepting your reality and acknowledging your emotions is the first and the foremost step that would help you to heal, survive and thrive after the break-up.

Nobody moves on in a day, so give yourself some time and prepare to deal with the good and not-so-good days ahead. You will be glad to realize that you came out to be stronger than you thought you were.

 

Do not overthink

It is good to think about what all went wrong in the relationship, learn your lesson and move on but make sure you are not overthinking anything. Just stay positive, and look forward to what life has in store for you!

 

Write a journal

Writing a journal can turn out to be a therapeutic and cathartic experience for you. Just pen down whatever is hovering in your mind. Also, figure out what all you can do to distract yourself (what about a trip to mountains or a pottery class?) and don’t just write, do it too!

 

Talk to the right people

Don’t think twice before seeking out support from your close friends and family members. Whether it is going on a dinner with them, sharing how you feel or simply asking them for advice, spending time with them will make you feel loved. Most importantly, it would be a reminder than you have many more relationships to cherish in life other than the romantic ones.

 

​Axe your ex

You have to talk to the ‘right’ people and staying friends with your ex-partner after the break-up is not a good idea. Talk to anyone you feel like but it is next to impossible to move on in life when you are talking to the person who is the reason for all your stress and heartache. You can be friends with your ex-lover only when you both have completely healed and have kept your past aside.

related.title: Sleeping Next To Someone Who Snores Is Bad For Your Mental Health: Study Says
related.title_hi: आपके मानसिक स्वास्थ्य के लिए बुरा कौन है, इसके बारे में जानने के लिए सो रहा है: अध्ययन कहता है
related.content:
Living with a partner is a great feeling, but it doesn't feel so great if you are a light sleeper and your partner is a snorer. In fact, it can cause mental illness and dampen your relationship with the real bad.

According to a study, losing sleep can have an impact on the body's ability to recover and fulfill biological functions like memory consolidation and metabolism regulation. It can also increase the risk of anxiety and the chances of suffering a stroke. 

It is also noticed that if a person is suffering from lack of sleep is a common cause of several mental health ailments like ADHD, depression, and anxiety. 

A study by Queen's University in Canada was also done on four couples where they analyzed the effects of snoring on both the snorers and their partners when it came to hearing loss.

The results showed that snorers weren't affected by the snoring sound and this is because the brain dampens respiratory interruptions during sleep. But, all of their partners did suffer from hearing loss especially in the ear that was exposed to snoring.

More than that, snoring can seriously have a negative impact on one's relationship as it can trigger stress, inflammation, problems with communicating and even depression in the long term. 

So, if your partner is complaining about the constant snoring, trust them, it is really affecting them more than you know.

related.title: The body part which you wash first while bathing reveals a LOT about your personality
related.title_hi: स्नान करते समय आप जिस अंग को धोते हैं, उससे आपके व्यक्तित्व के बारे में बहुत कुछ पता चलता है
related.content:
Everything we do, whether consciously or sub-consciously says something about us. Every decision we make acts as a piece of the puzzle which finally shapes our personality.

 

Did you know that you sub-consciously prioritize your body parts when you go to shower? The body part that you wash first--in the whole process of bathing-- tells the amount of importance you place on that specific body part.

 

This order reveals something interesting about your personality. Let’s explore.

 

1. Face

If you wash your face first, it means that you place a lot of importance on how others perceive you. It also means that you get frustrated easily and are extremely anxious about what others think of you. You might also get embarrassed at the drop of the hat and it is difficult for you to take even healthy criticism in a sporty spirit.

 

2. Armpits

If you tend to wash your armpits first, you are very popular in social circles and your friends adore you. You are known to stand by your friends in good and bad times. 9. ​Hair

Everyone, brace yourself! The revelations of recent research have created a buzz in the world of love and relationships. It seems marrying a curvy woman is actually beneficial for your happiness levels and in turn, could be one of the factors behind a happy marriage. Guess what, even science backs up this notion. Read on…

 

​The study

The researchers at the National Autonomous University of Mexico surveyed hundreds of couples and came up with an interesting correlation between a woman’s size and her partner’s happiness level. The study concluded that men who marry chubby women are TEN times happier than all the other men.

 

​Not just this

The study also indicated that men who marry chubby women smile more often than the ones who are in a relationship with thin partners. Plus, the research indicated that plump women are better at dealing with issues in a relationship. Seriously?

 

What about the thin ones?

The researchers delved into the character traits of women and opined thin woman is more on reserved and unfriendly side. In fact, the study referred to them as less expressive which may impact the happiness levels in a relationship.

 

However!

Irrespective of the findings of the study, what matters the most is that all of us own up to our bodies, whatever may be the size. The only thing that makes that matters is that you are fit, healthy and in charge of your own life. You will be able to make your partner happy only when you are at peace with yourself and joyful inside, right?
